cards.text: Moses is still preaching to Israel, and they haven't gone into the land yet. So he looks ahead to the day they enter the land the LORD is giving them, take possession of it and settle in. When that day comes, he's got a job for them.

cards.question: Once Israel is settled in the land, Moses says to put some of the ___ of all their produce in a basket.

cards.text: Then they carry that basket to the place the LORD will choose as a dwelling for His Name and walk up to the priest serving at that time. No drop box, no porch delivery, friend. You show up in PERSON.

cards.question: Basket in hand, what does the worshiper declare to the priest?

answers.text: I have entered the land the LORD swore to give us
I have gathered more than any year before this one
I have kept every vow my fathers made to the LORD

cards.text: The priest takes the basket and sets it before the altar of the LORD. Then the worshiper tells a story out loud, starting with "My father was a wandering Aramean."

cards.question: In the worshiper's story, that wandering Aramean was already a great nation when he went down to Egypt.

cards.text: But the story turns hard. The Egyptians mistreat them and put them to hard labor, so they call out to the LORD, the God of their fathers.

cards.question: When they call out from their hard labor in Egypt, what does the worshiper say the LORD does?

answers.text: He hears their voice and sees their affliction
He tells them to keep working and endure it
He waits for them to fix things on their own

cards.text: Then the LORD brings them out of Egypt with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm, with great terror, signs and wonders. My big exit from the junk drawer? I left a note on a takeout menu. Their exit? Signs and WONDERS.

cards.question: After bringing them out of Egypt, where does the worshiper say the LORD brought them?

answers.text: To this land flowing with milk and honey
Back to the land of Haran to settle down
To the wilderness of Sinai to stay for good

cards.text: Then the worshiper says, "And now, behold, I have brought the firstfruits of the land that You, O LORD, have given me." That's the whole story, from wandering to wonders, in ONE basket.

cards.question: After placing the basket before the LORD, the worshiper bows down before Him.
Then the worshiper ___ in all the good things the LORD has given, along with the Levite and the ___ living among them.

cards.text: Next, Moses moves from firstfruits to the tithe. In the third year, the year of the tithe, they set aside a tenth of all their produce. One out of ten, and FINALLY, a math problem I can handle.

cards.question: That third-year tithe goes to the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless and the widow, so they can eat and be filled within Israel's gates.

cards.text: Then the giver declares before the LORD that the sacred portion is out of the house and given away, just as He commanded. Not one of His commandments broken or forgotten.

cards.question: In that same declaration, the giver admits to eating some of the sacred portion while in mourning.
How does the giver sum up that whole report to the LORD?

answers.text: I have done everything You commanded me
I have done most of what You asked of me
I will try harder after the next harvest

cards.text: Friend, that's not a report. That's a timesheet with ZERO gaps. Then the giver looks up and prays, "Look down from Your holy habitation, from heaven."

cards.question: The giver asks the LORD to ___ His people Israel and the ___ He gave them, as He swore to their fathers.

cards.text: Now Moses brings it home. The LORD their God commands them this day to follow these statutes and ordinances.

cards.question: How carefully does Moses say Israel must follow these statutes and ordinances?

answers.text: With all their heart and all their soul
On the feast days and in the good seasons
Whenever the priests come to remind them

cards.text: Moses says that today Israel has proclaimed the LORD is their God, and that they'll walk in His ways, keep His commandments and listen to His voice. That's not a "we'll see," friend. That's a PROCLAMATION.

cards.question: Israel has proclaimed the LORD is their God. What does Moses say the LORD has proclaimed about Israel?

answers.text: They are His people and treasured possession
They have earned the land by their hard work
They will never face a hard day ever again

cards.question: Moses says the LORD will set Israel high in praise, name and honor above all the nations He has made.

cards.text: And they'll be a holy people to the LORD their God, just as He promised. That's where we'll leave Moses for now, friend, because this sermon still has more to say.
